gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/final recommended=1

This PR by alex adds an on-demand CSV export to the reports page: an Export CSV button that downloads the report table, including every column, through a handler that pages in bounded chunks so a large report cannot hold the request open. The spec defers emailing exports and recording export events in the audit log to acme/widgets#46, and the paging and deadline that support the five-second speed target are covered here, while the speed on production data can only be checked after merge; you are not the author and no pending review request names you.

Nothing blocks merging. The test check passed in CI on the commit being reviewed, and the description's statement that it adds tests for the CSV handler matches the new test file. One smaller point does not block merging: the export handler pages with its own loop instead of reusing the shared paging helper in lib/page.ts (src/api/export.ts:31). The fix nits row can take it.

I recommend merge because nothing blocks it and you have write access to the repository.

3. fix nits - replace the handler's own paging loop with the shared helper, review the change, push it, watch the checks, and come back here.
4. stop - leave the PR and the worktree as they are.
